steps.content: [Room in a Luxurious Manor]

steps.speaker: Advisor
steps.content: Sir, information regarding the <color=#fb9259>Unity Gala</color> has been discreetly channeled to our reliable allies in the farlands. For those leading figures who have shown us steadfast support, we've assured them generous allocations of Hypercube and Aurum Secretum to strengthen their positions.

steps.speaker: Advisor
steps.content: As for those whose loyalties have been... fluid, maintaining covert ties with both DisCity and Ms. Margaret... we are dispatching a diplomatic team to encourage clearer alignment. For the remaining obstinate few, well, the gala's inevitable chaos will provide cover for certain regrettable, yet permanent, resolutions.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: And DisCity? Any word on <color=#fb9259>Adelaide Campbell</color>?

steps.speaker: Advisor
steps.content: Nothing concrete yet. However, we have confirmed that <color=#fb9259>Hypatia Campbell</color> has escaped Senate custody and is currently under Ms. Margaret's protection. The Senate is outraged and demands she be branded a traitor and dealt with accordingly.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Outraged? Please. This is precisely the outcome those old vultures anticipated. Let them posture.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: That said, there is someone who has been a persistent nuisance to the Luminaris Society. We will use his identity. Make sure the work's clean. I will not have DisCity holding another scrap of evidence against us.
[Rooftop]

Night falls deep over Fraser. The city's sleepless lights have transformed the sky into a profound wash of gold and purple. Against this dusky canopy, a pitch-black figure darts across the rooftops, a swift shadow closing in on a luxurious villa.
His movements are light as a bat, a silent dance that expertly skirts every security measure. In moments, he reaches the target window. With one fluid motion, he opens it and slips inside.
[Hotel Room]
The assassin approaches the bed, where the soft blankets rise in the gentle shape of a sleeping form. His target.
A flick of his wrist, and a dagger—crimson and dark—appears in his hand. He aims for the center of that shape and drives the blade down.
(Flash of light)
The strike meets not flesh, but metal. Before the shock can register, a piercing alarm shatters the silence, blaring through every corridor of the villa.
The shadowy figure tilts his head, dodging the attack from the darkness. He instantly abandons the decoy in the bed and moves to retreat, only for a rush of air to whistle behind his head.
CLANG!!!
A silver blade meets his black-red dagger in a midair parry. In the flash of light from the collision, both adversaries see each other clearly for the first time.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: The Senate? No, you're not from Fraser. Who are you?
He is a tall, imposing figure, his face obscured by layer upon layer of bandages. Only his eyes are visible, fierce and glaring from the linen depths.
Yet, the strangeness of his visage is secondary. Far more dangerous is the baleful black-red glow that sheathes his blade, a lingering remnant of sorcery from the Underground.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Careful! He's using the Underground sorcery!
The assassin offers no reply. Instead, he snaps the bedsheet into the air, blinding Helga, and uses the bed frame to launch himself straight at Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.content: Confirm... target... die.
